title: Especialista de Planejamento de Demanda
description:
Resumo da Posição:

O Planejador de Demanda é responsável por desenvolver, manter e atualizar previsões de demanda para produtos, garantindo um planejamento preciso e colaborativo que suporte as necessidades comerciais, supply chain, compras e produção. O profissional atuará como o elo entre as áreas comerciais, marketing e operações, assegurando que a empresa tenha uma visão clara da demanda futura, minimizando rupturas e excesso de estoque, além de contribuir para a otimização da cadeia de suprimentos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Logística, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em planejamento de demanda, supply chain ou áreas de planejamento e controle (MANDATORIO)
  • Conhecimento avançado de ferramentas de planejamento de demanda e sistemas ERP (ex: Plannera, SAP IBP, etc).
  • Experiência com modelos estatísticos e previsões quantitativas.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e utilização de ferramentas como Excel (avançado), Power BI ou outras plataformas de Business Intelligence.
  • Experiência em participação em processos de S&OP.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com diversas áreas funcionais.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com alta atenção a detalhes e gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.
  • Habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico

Diferenciais (Desejável):

  • Experiência em empresas com operações complexas e multi-regionais.

Atividades

  • Desenvolver e atualizar previsões de demanda com base em análises estatísticas de dados históricos, sazonalidade, tendências de mercado e informações de clientes:
  • Obter e organizar dados históricos de vendas, variações sazonais e campanhas de marketing anteriores, garantindo que estejam completos e consistentes para análise.
  • Trabalhar com dados internos (histórico de vendas, promoções passadas) e externos (dados de mercado, tendências econômicas, clima, etc.)
  • Utilizar modelos estatísticos, como séries temporais (ARIMA, média móvel, suavização exponencial) e técnicas de regressão, para gerar previsões de demanda.
  • Avaliar e selecionar o modelo mais adequado para cada tipo de produto ou categoria, dependendo do comportamento da demanda.
  • Identificar padrões sazonais e cíclicos que possam influenciar a demanda, ajustando as previsões para diferentes períodos do ano. Adaptar as previsões conforme mudanças no mercado ou em condições econômicas.
  • Incorporar Tendências de Mercado: Analisar dados de tendências de mercado e comportamento de clientes
  • Utilizar informações qualitativas das equipes de vendas e marketing para ajustar previsões, incluindo aspectos como ciclos de vida de produtos.
  • Participar ativamente do processo de S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning), revisando e ajustando previsões com base em restrições de capacidade, metas financeiras e necessidades de mercado.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das previsões de demanda (acurácia de forecast) e implementar melhorias contínuas para aumentar a precisão.
  • Acompanhar KPIs relacionados à demanda, como forecast accuracy, nível de serviço, cobertura de estoque e giro de inventário, entre outros;
  • Comunicar os resultados e insights das previsões para stakeholders internos, ajudando na tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos de ruptura de estoque e sobrecarga de inventário, recomendando ações corretivas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas e softwares especializados de planejamento de demanda para realizar análises detalhadas e cenários “what-if” para otimização.
  • Desenvolver diferentes cenários de previsão para simular mudanças no mercado ou variáveis internas, como variações de preço, alterações no mix de produtos ou lançamentos de novas linhas, e avaliar o impacto dessas alterações na demanda projetada.
  • Manter a integridade e a atualização dos dados nos sistemas de planejamento, garantindo que todas as informações de demanda sejam precisas e atualizadas.
  • Propor e liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua em processos de previsão e planejamento de demanda.

Joining this team means you’re motivated to seek solutions to problems and work with other disciplines to make positive changes to workflows, tools, and technologies that directly impact Gameplay.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with technical animators, Leads, Directors, and Outsource Managers on the team to ensure assets are set up for success in the different stages of production

  • Assisting with pipeline tools and working with engine and project leads on the continuous improvement of those engine tools
  • Setting up assets in Unreal Engine 5; including control rigs, cloth, physics, and blueprints
  • Rigging characters, weapons, creatures, and vehicles. Maintain detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support internal and external artists

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya and/or Unreal Engine
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • A positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver
  • Control Rig experience a plus
  • Python programming is a plus

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

title: Component Leader(d/f/m)
description:
We are seeking an Elevator Architect to join our R&D team and assist us in creating a standard global elevator product architecture, which includes the functional definition of modules and module interfaces.

You will be a member of the Global Product Architecture Team, which comprises system architecture methodology experts who coordinate and drive the creation of deliverables for the Modular Product Architecture Project.

You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders from R&D, PLM, PSM, MFG, and Field/Sales, as well as experts in all product areas, to standardize key module interfaces to minimize rework when module implementation changes.

You will also participate in the Product Architecture Update Process, which establishes the methodology and standard work for updating the architecture and standard interfaces.

This activity is a high priority for our company, as it will enable R&D efficiency and cost reduction for all elevator products.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Platform Development: Lead the development and maintenance of core platform components, including kernel modules, device drivers, board support packages (BSPs), and hardware abstraction layers, ensuring seamless integration with hardware and higher-level software layers.
  2. System Image Customization: Lead the creation of Linux-based system images using the Yocto Project, tailoring configurations to meet specific hardware and project requirements.
  3. Platform Tooling and Abstraction Layers: Build and maintain tools, APIs, and abstraction layers that simplify application development. Provide a reliable and efficient platform that enables application teams to focus on delivering innovative solutions.
  4. Team Leadership and Mentorship: Lead and mentor a team of developers focused on platform development. Cultivate technical growth within the team by sharing expertise in embedded software development. Promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability to achieve high-quality deliverables.
  5. Planning and Transparency: Track team progress and ensure alignment with project timelines and deliverables. Maintain clear visibility into development activities, identify risks early, and adjust plans as needed to meet committed deadlines. Report progress and challenges to stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.
  6. Collaboration and Team Work: Work closely with the Technical Leader, Product Owner, other Component Leaders and stakeholders to align platform development with broader project goals. Collaborate with hardware engineers, platform, application and test automation teams to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across the solution.

Qualifications:

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  2. Experience: 7+ years of experience in embedded systems development, with a focus on low-level programming and Linux-based platforms.
  3. Skills:
    • Strong knowledge of embedded Linux systems, kernel programming, and hardware-software integration.
    • Experience with the Yocto Project for system image building and customization.
    • Proficiency in developing device drivers, BSPs, and hardware abstraction layers.
    • Familiarity with hardware and networking communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, TCP/IP, GSM.
    • Strong experience with troubleshooting of complex problems in diverse environments.
    • Basic knowledge for reading electronic schematics and datasheets.
    • Familiarity with end-to-end testing approaches and test automation, preferably with hardware-in-the-loop testing, to ensure reliable integration and quality of embedded systems.
    • Experience with Agile methodologies, backlog prioritization, and tools like JIRA and Confluence.
  4. Soft Skills:
    • Strong ability to interact and align with stakeholders and technical leaders across the company, ensuring effective communication and shared understanding of project goals.
    • Proven ability to contribute to a collaborative team environment, always working as a team player and actively supporting colleagues and driving collective success.
    • Highly collaborative with excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
    • Clear and effective communicator, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment, managing multiple priorities and adjusting to shifting requirements.
  5. Language: Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Experience with hardware development.
  2. Experience working in a global environment with cross-functional teams.
  3. Background in digital transformation, connectivity solutions, or IoT in the industrial or building automation sector.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto, a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Articulador Social atuará na linha de frente do projeto Rede Liderança, Oficinas e Palestras comunitárias na área de concessão da Enel SP. A função interage diretamente com os parceiros envolvidos (Associações de moradores, representantes de bairro, ONGs, grupos produtivos comunitários, instituições religiosas, universidades, instituições públicas e privadas), organizando e realizando os eventos.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Preparação e condução das reuniões de liderança com metodologia de mediação de grupos e dinâmicas;
  2. Organização e realização de Oficinas para mulheres e Palestras comunitárias;
  3. Manter um canal de comunicação próximo e direto com os parceiros, possibilitando a melhoria da qualidade dos serviços prestados pela Enel, minimizando conflitos e gerando valor compartilhado;
  4. Criar e propor estratégias de abordagem com os grupos;
  5. Realizar visitas institucionais para identificação das lideranças comunitárias;
  6. Proceder com o mapeamento e análise dos perfis das lideranças comunitárias;
  7. Prospectar líderes comunitários para fins de aplicação de questionários;
  8. Analisar e mapear os resultados e objetivos alcançados;
  9. Identificar temas levantados pelos participantes dos grupos e propor as temáticas das reuniões;
  10. Enviar relatórios periódicos de desempenho das ações do projeto;
  11. Prospectar possíveis grupos produtivos de interesse da ENEL;
  12. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  13. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;
  14. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do setor.

description:

Quer trabalhar em um ambiente onde você encanta e é encantado a todo momento? Então, se liga nessa oportunidade:

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Produto (Infantil ou Feminino);
  • Experiência com Adobe Illustrator;
  • Inglês avançado e/ou fluente para participar de reuniões com fornecedores internacionais;
  • Office avançado;

O que é que te encanta? Muito além da maior varejista de moda do país, somos um Ecossistema no qual criamos o futuro, inovamos e solucionamos diferentes desafios. Todos os dias aprendemos algo novo, desenvolvemos habilidades e aprimoramos talentos. Aqui, temos o sentimento de pertencimento, respeitamos o diverso e trabalhamos em um ambiente no qual cuidamos e somos cuidados. Nossa consciência ambiental e social está presente em todas as ações, pois temos compromisso claro com os colaboradores, clientes e fornecedores. Se o que te encanta é poder aprender, compartilhar e ensinar. Se o que te encanta é o respeito, a diversidade e a inclusão. Seu lugar é aqui. Junte-se ao time de 24 mil colaboradores que estão reunidos para encantar ao lado das marcas Renner, Camicado, Youcom, Ashua, Repassa e Realize. E aí, vem fazer moda responsável com a gente?

description:
Estamos com uma posição para Engenheiro técnico de produto com foco em biquíni. Suas atividades estarão voltadas para o desenvolvimento, melhoria e controle de qualidade de produtos têxteis, atuando em diversas etapas do processo de criação e fabricação, garantindo que os produtos atendam aos requisitos técnicos e de mercado.

Atribuições e responsabilidades:

  1. Análise e Desenvolvimento de Produto
    • Desenvolver protótipos de novos produtos, considerando o design, materiais, funcionalidades e estética.
    • Elaborar fichas técnicas detalhadas com todas as especificações do produto (materiais, cores, tamanhos, acabamentos, técnicas de costura, etc.).
    • Avaliar e selecionar materiais adequados para cada tipo de produto, garantindo qualidade e adequação à funcionalidade do design.
  2. Processo de Produção
    • Definir os processos produtivos necessários para fabricar os produtos conforme os requisitos de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos.
    • Ajustar padrões de produção, como cortes, modelagem e costura, para garantir que o produto final atenda às especificações.
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção, identificar possíveis problemas técnicos e sugerir soluções para otimizar o processo.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Realizar inspeções durante e após a produção para verificar se os produtos atendem aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
    • Coordenar ou realizar testes de durabilidade, resistência, lavagem e outros parâmetros técnicos para assegurar a conformidade do produto final.
    • Identificar e tratar desvios de qualidade, propondo melhorias ou ajustes nos processos produtivos ou de design.
  4. Ajustes e Melhorias Contínuas
    • Coletar feedback de clientes, áreas de vendas e outras partes envolvidas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos.
    • Propor melhorias no processo de produção visando reduzir custos, melhorar a eficiência e garantir a qualidade.
    • Acompanhar inovações tecnológicas no setor têxtil e sugerir a implementação de novas técnicas ou equipamentos que melhorem o produto ou o processo produtivo.
  5. Gestão de Documentação Técnica
    • Atualizar constantemente as fichas técnicas, garantindo que as informações estejam corretas e acessíveis para as equipes de produção e comercialização.
    • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o andamento do desenvolvimento de produtos, incluindo testes, qualidade e melhorias implementadas.
  6. Interação com Outras Áreas
    • Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de design e estilistas para garantir que as ideias criativas sejam viáveis do ponto de vista técnico e de produção.
    • Fornecer suporte técnico para a equipe comercial, ajudando a explicar os diferenciais e especificações dos produtos aos clientes ou consumidores.
    • Treinar os operadores de produção, modelistas e outros profissionais envolvidos na fabricação sobre os processos e padrões exigidos.
  7. Sustentabilidade e Conformidade
    • Trabalhar para implementar práticas de produção mais sustentáveis, selecionando materiais ecológicos e otimizando processos para reduzir desperdícios.
    • Garantir que os produtos atendam às normas de segurança, regulamentos ambientais e padrões internacionais de qualidade.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia têxtil;

Experiência em varejo de moda, com foco em biquíni.

Join to apply for the Support Engineering Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders across sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing, with a distributed team of 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries. Teams meet in person a few times a year in various locations worldwide.

Our regional Support Managers lead world-class support teams—solving complex technical problems for customers using Ubuntu Server, Desktop, and the public cloud. Key attributes include customer focus and technical excellence. We are hiring managers for both our Cloud Support Group and Devices Support Group.

The role involves:

  1. Managing a professional support team, including skills development and performance management.
  2. Operational control, shift scheduling, and KPI accountability.
  3. Ensuring customer cases are responded to within SLA and professionally.
  4. Acting as the escalation contact for customers.
  5. Maintaining customer satisfaction.
  6. Contributing to the knowledge base.
  7. Improving team processes and support delivery.
  8. Hiring, developing, and training support staff.
  9. Collaborating with leadership on growth and transformation initiatives.

Qualifications include:

  • Extensive CLI experience with Linux (Support, Development, Implementation).
  • Leadership and team management experience.
  • Ability to work under pressure with a strong customer focus.
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in another language is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Knowledge of Linux Desktop, OpenStack, Public Cloud, or Virtualization.
  • Contributions to Open Source projects.
  • Software development experience.
  • Experience in support organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with Canonical's products.

We offer:

  • A distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • A USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Annual compensation reviews and performance bonuses.
  • Additional benefits aligned with our values, including holiday leave, parental leave, Employee Assistance Programme, travel opportunities, and more.

About Canonical:

We are pioneers in open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud computing. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster a remote-friendly culture since 2004. Working here challenges you to think differently and grow your skills.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications fairly, regardless of background or identity.

description:
Sobre nós:

A Argenta é uma empresa brasileira com uma longa história. Fundada em 1985, pelos irmãos Neco e Deunir Argenta, consolidou-se como uma referência no setor de varejo de combustíveis e lojas de conveniência no Brasil.

Nossa estrutura

Hoje, somos mais de 6 mil funcionários atuando em nove empresas que fazem parte do nosso ecossistema: Sim Rede de Postos, Sim Distribuidora, Sim Lubrificantes, Querodiesel, Charrua, A27, Aiva, Sim Aviação e Luiz Argenta.

Visão de Futuro

A Argenta busca constantemente reinventar-se e superar desafios, com a visão de construir um futuro melhor para seus funcionários, clientes e comunidade.

Somos um ecossistema sólido, com uma cultura forte e uma visão de futuro promissora. Buscamos talentos que queiram percorrer conosco este caminho.

Se você possui espírito de servir, de fazer sempre o melhor, de encantar quem está ao seu redor e é movido por desafios, a Argenta é o seu lugar e a oportunidade abaixo é para você!

Valorizamos e estamos comprometidos com todas as formas de inclusão e diversidade.

Quer trilhar sua história com a gente?

Estamos com a oportunidade deTécnico de Segurança do Trabalho, com atuaçãoem viagens em Santa Catarina, Paraná, Litoral Norte do RS .

Atividade:

Acompanhar e auxiliar no desenvolvimento de programas como PGR, LTCAT, PCMSO, PPP bem como a execução do plano de ação;

Preparar programas, campanhas e palestras educativas a fim de conscientizar os funcionários quanto a atitudes seguras;

Determinar e acompanhar o trabalhador quanto à utilização dos equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs), determinante para a função;

Acompanhar e colaborar na realização de projetos de modificações ou nas novas instalações da empresa, visando a criação de condições mais seguras no trabalho;

Realizar e participar de auditorias internas, acompanhando e avaliando as áreas para trabalhar medidas de segurança e atendimento das NRs;

Garantir a realização de treinamentos de integração de segurança, brigada de emergência, NR-20 e outros relacionados à segurança do trabalho;

Controlar o trabalho de terceiros, no que diz respeito ao cumprimento das normas de segurança;

Garantir que as unidades possuam a documentação de segurança e processos conforme previsto na legislação;

Investigar e analisar os acidentes, recomendando medidas de prevenção e controle dos mesmos, a fim de minimizar os riscos;

Realizar inspeções de segurança nas unidades da empresa, propondo melhorias para eliminação de riscos;

Promover a cultura de segurança na empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Curso técnico de segurança completo com registro ativo no Ministério do Trabalho (obrigatório);
  • Conhecimento básico no Pacote Office (obrigatório);
  • Disponibilidade para realizar viagens (obrigatório);
  • Residir em Itajaí ou cidades próximas como Brusque, Navegantes;
  • CHN categoria B (obrigatório);
  • Conhecimento na área de Varejo (desejável);
  • Domínio em NR-20 e brigada de emergência (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de segurança do trabalho (desejável).

O que oferecemos?

  • Plano de Saúde da Unimed custeado 50% do valor pela empresa para o funcionário;
  • Cartão de benefícios flexíveis Caju para utilizar de acordo com sua necessidade.
  • Auxílio Educação para cursos de pós-graduação após 6 meses de casa.
  • Desconto no valor do combustível para funcionário, válido para qualquer Unidade da Rede SIM.
  • Reembolso em viagens fora do local de trabalho.

Nossos valores

A Argenta destaca-se por valores fortes que construíram e mantêm a sua cultura:

  • Ambiente agradável: pessoas felizes em um ambiente limpo e agradável.
  • Confiança: faça o correto sempre.
  • Cuidar das pessoas: dignidade, respeito e oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Inovar sempre: fazer mais com menos, inovando sempre juntos.
  • Paixão por servir: aqui tem oportunidades para quem quer encantar as pessoas.
  • Sentimento de dono: equipe que se realiza com as conquistas.
  • Simplificar: faça simples, seguindo as regras.

title: Support Engineering Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Support Engineering Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders across sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing, with a global distributed team of 1200+ colleagues in over 75 countries.

Our regional Support Managers lead world-class Support teams, solving deep technical problems for customers using Ubuntu Server, Desktop, and public cloud solutions. They prioritize customer satisfaction and technical excellence, ensuring the support team stays current with technology and performs efficient troubleshooting. We seek managers for our Cloud Support Group and Devices Support Group.

The role involves:

  1. Managing a professional support team, including skills development and performance management.
  2. Operational control, shift scheduling, and accountability for KPIs.
  3. Responding to customer cases within SLAs and professionally.
  4. Acting as the escalation contact for customers.
  5. Ensuring customer satisfaction.
  6. Contributing to the support knowledge base.
  7. Continuously improving team processes and support delivery.
  8. Hiring, developing, and training support staff.
  9. Collaborating with leadership on growth and transformation initiatives.

We seek candidates with:

  • Extensive CLI experience with Linux (Support, Development, Implementation).
  • Leadership and team management experience.
  • Ability to work under pressure with a strong customer focus.
  • Fluency in English and preferably another language.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Knowledge of Linux Desktop, OpenStack, Public Cloud, or Virtualization.
  • Contribution to Open Source projects.
  • Software development experience.
  • Experience in support organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with Canonical's products.

We offer:

  • A distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • A personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 annually.
  • Annual compensation review and performance-based bonuses.
  • Additional benefits reflecting our values, including holiday leave, parental leave, Employee Assistance Programme, travel opportunities, and more.

About Canonical:

We are a pioneering open source company, publishing Ubuntu and leading in AI, IoT, and cloud platforms. We recruit globally, uphold high standards, and foster a diverse, inclusive workplace. Working here means thinking differently, working smarter, and continuously learning.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Senior Delivery Consultant - Databases to join our team at AWS. Preferred Qualifications

Função
Prazo indeterminado

O que você vai fazer por aqui?

  • Gestão de Boas Práticas: realizar auditorias nas plataformas de mídia para garantir a aplicação das Golden Rules de Precision Marketing, identificando GAPs e apoiando o feedback para as agências;

O que você vai encontrar por aqui?
Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Além de oferecer benefícios voltados ao bem-estar social, físico, financeiro, mental e emocional, promovemos um ambiente de prosperidade, pertencimento e propósito, fortalecendo uma rede sólida de apoio, expansão de consciência e respeito à diversidade, equidade e inclusão.

A Natura celebra e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

When you see a potential issue, you never leave things hanging and unfinished. When you and your team deliver a finished product, it's as polished as you could make it.

description:
EBANX is a global fintech founded in 2012 with a mission to be the leading payments partner in rising markets. With its own technology and infrastructure, combined with in-depth knowledge of the Latin American market, EBANX allows these companies to connect to hundreds of payment methods in different countries in the region. And it goes further, creating results for businesses and simple shopping experiences for consumers.

From the beginning of our journey, we have an important mission: to give access . And this is not just about our products and services, but it goes through everything we are and do. We believe that it is only possible to innovate with diversity, so we cherish differences in gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion and age. Plurality is what makes our Big Dream possible.

We are called ebankers and we are changing the way people buy, connect, and live globally. Let's make history together?

As a Software Engineering Specialist , you will be part of EBANX's core technical team. Our group owns the entire cross-border and local payment processing platforms.

The payment platform is the flagship product of EBANX. Our team is responsible for its development, expansion, and evolution, alongside balancing the requirements and projects for other vital areas such as Product, Commercial, and Operations.

What you will do:

  • You will be required to promote an engineering culture that cherishes high quality and flexible code to foster a culture of excellence;
  • Actively promote the development of our technical leadership pipeline;
  • Sponsor the development and evolution of internal tools and practices to achieve all above;

What is indispensable for the job?

  • Proven experience of at least 7 years designing, implementing, and deploying software solutions to production, including at least 2 years of experience as a technical leader;
  • Proven experience of at least 5 years with Object-oriented programming;
  • Vision for software quality, the evolution of systems, decomposition of problems and abstractions;
  • Ability to learn new practices, technologies, programming languages and absorbing engineering culture;
  • Knowledge in subjects such as data structures, concurrency, persistence, and distributed systems;

What would we love to see?

  • Software development expertise in any complementary area to our core business, such as data warehouses, specialized development platforms, infrastructure automation, services provisioning, real-time systems, fault-tolerant systems, and mission-critical systems;
  • Experience with deploying to and monitoring a cloud infrastructure especially AWS;
  • Experience with computer networks, latency, package loss, routing optimization, monitoring, and problem-solving;
  • Full knowledge of SQL and relational databases;
  • Expertise in at least one functional or logic programming language
  • Comfortable with challenges of concurrency problems and has already worked in distributed and asynchronous systems;

What are we going to offer so you can do an amazing job?

  • Sustainable work pace: 40 solid hours a week of an accelerated but not frenetic rhythm - almost no marathons or sleepless nights; The focus is on working smarter.
  • Company provided toolset so you can be productive in your work; (Macbook, Jetbrains licenses, Slack, Discord, Zoom, Confluence, Bitbucket, Jenkins, DataDog, Rollbar, ElasticSearch, Kibana, SonarQube)
  • Code reviews for any of your pull requests - You will also do a lot of them :)
  • Constant discussions about our practices and systems, everybody that wants to speak out will be heard and we are open to new ideas, practices, and tools;
  • You will be free to dedicate part of your time to improve our systems and implement quality features that make us more efficient or less error-prone;
  • Annual performance evaluations;

EBANX offers:

  • A challenging environment, with opportunities to grow;
  • Casual office and dress code;
  • Spanish, English and Portuguese classes;
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;

  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents, and medicine subsidy for ebankers;

  • Hello ebanker: psychology, finance and legal orientation.
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics store and more!

title: Cloud Field Engineering Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical .

This is an opportunity to lead a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions across public clouds and data centers. The role involves working with a broad spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu to virtualization, private cloud, Kubernetes, and advanced open source solutions like MLops platforms and data platforms. As Canonical expands into new industries such as telecom, finance, healthcare, and media, we develop new open source solutions tailored to their needs.

We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers, comfortable troubleshooting technical issues and engaging in technical presales. They should contribute technically but focus more on shaping team direction, focus, and delivery. We also focus on growing management skills and soft skills in our engineers.

Our goal is to make open source easier, reliable, and secure, aiming to provide 'most software to most companies'. We select engineers globally for brilliance and motivation, and our managers help teams achieve their potential and take pride in their results.

The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical

The team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical works directly with customers to design private and public cloud solutions tailored to workload needs. Technologies include on-premise solutions like Openstack, MicroCloud, Ceph, and deployable solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL. Managers and team members deploy, test, and hand over solutions, and participate in presales to advise during sales processes.

The manager is responsible for line management, career guidance, developing engineering talent, representing the team technically, and driving collaboration with other teams and customers. Active participation in presales is also expected.

Location

This role is home-based, managing a team in your time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting technologies and acting as a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in your time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and provide career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and products to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and promote best engineering and organizational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on goals and projects
  • Participate in leadership team collaborations

What we are looking for in you

  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies (Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph)
  • Practical Linux and networking skills
  • Experience in technical presales
  • Dynamic personality, proactive in new projects and interacting with people
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Passion for developing and growing people
  • Experience leading, coaching, and mentoring engineers
  • Organized, ensuring timely, high-quality results
  • Strong academic background
  • Willingness to travel up to 40%, attending events and meetings

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Second language (Spanish or French) preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience with external partnerships
  • Stakeholder engagement with internal teams and engineering roadmaps

What we offer you

Our compensation considers location, experience, and performance, with annual reviews and performance bonuses. Benefits include:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints
  • USD 2,000 yearly learning and development budget
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards, holiday leave, parental leave, Employee Assistance Programme
  • Travel opportunities and upgrades for company events

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers in open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster excellence. Since 2004, as a remote-first company, we challenge you to think differently, learn new skills, and innovate.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion, offering fair consideration regardless of background or identity.

description:
Job Title: Store Manager

Req#: 00284939-304a-4252-b14a-b11c00ef2443

The Store Manager (SM) is responsible for managing all aspects of the business, with minimal direct supervision from the General Manager (GM), to ensure that Guests are delighted with a fast, friendly, fresh, clean, and in stock shopping experience, teaching and demonstrating core values, and supporting the GM in achieving store goals and initiatives. The SM assists the GM in maintaining a Staffed, Stable & Scheduled environment by providing a consistent Team Member experience through training, coaching, and recognition, while fostering a safety culture by Believing in Zero.

Essential Job Functions (Responsible to)

  1. Drive a safety culture by ensuring a clean, organized, and safe environment for all Team Members and Guests. Ensure proper procedure is followed relating to safety, accidents, and incidents including reporting, investigations, and documentation.
  2. Create a place of welcoming and belonging for our Guests and Team Members.
  3. Oversee the daily execution of the Store Operating System through management of the Game Plans to deliver a consistent Guest/brand experience that enables the store to achieve performance targets and improve financial performance; ability to delegate tasks accordingly and follow up to ensure completion.
  4. Engage and lead company initiatives.
  5. Oversee fresh food production to ensure food safety requirements are always met and par levels are maintained for a craveable and consistent offering, while growing sales and controlling waste.
  6. Develop well trained Team Members by following Thorntons’ training processes as prescribed while demonstrating and teaching our core values.
  7. Support and guide Team Members through career path while holding Team Members to a high standard of execution through coaching and accountability via Thorntons’ Progressive Discipline Process.
  8. Assist GM in facilitating the labor model by ensuring the team is working the schedule to our standard to maintain adequate coverage for all shifts.
  9. Train and empower Team Members to de-escalate Guest service issues.
  10. Communicate with Team Members in a positive manner that motivates and inspires them to act in accordance with Plan to Win strategy.
  11. Use a point-of-sale cash register and other electronic equipment.
  12. Comply with all federal, state, and local inspectors by taking immediate and appropriate action, and communicating and maintaining records of all inspections, certificates, and necessary records.
  13. Perform additional duties as assigned.

Key Relationships

  1. Region Manager
  2. General Manager
  3. Guest Service Representative
  4. Human Resource Manager
  5. Recruiter
  6. Trainer
  7. Auditor

Skills

  1. Demonstrates a commitment to leading by example, considering no tasks as below one’s position.
  2. Contributes to setting work priorities and direction, supporting the team in achieving goals and objectives.
  3. Demonstrates a positive and approachable presence, even during stressful situations.
  4. Recognizes positive performance, celebrates team achievements, and addresses poor performance.
  5. Provides feedback effectively and with empathy.
  6. Collaborates with GM to deliver high-quality Guest service.
  7. Fosters team camaraderie, collaboration, and cohesion.
  8. Proactively identifies potential issues and works with GM to take action to avoid workplace disruptions.
  9. Uses 'active listening' to understand viewpoints of others. Adjusts one's position/view to try and resolve conflict.
  10. Uses analytical skills to identify and solve a variety of business-related problems.
  11. Uses basic arithmetical skills to add, subtract and divide as necessary to complete financial reports, cash, inventory, etc.
  12. Values diversity and recognizes the strengths that individuals from divergent life experiences and backgrounds bring to the team.

Knowledge

  1. Principles and processes for providing Guest Service. This includes Guest needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of Guest satisfaction.
  2. Principles and methods for displaying, promoting, and selling products or services.
  3. Principles and procedures for personnel recruitment, selection, and training.

Minimum one (1) year of management in retail and/or food and beverage industries.

NA

  1. High School Diploma or GED (required).
  2. Must have reliable transportation.
  3. Valid driver’s license (preferred).
  4. Food Safety and Handling Certifications (This is preferred. If not possessed upon hire, must have the ability to obtain one).

Physical Requirements

  1. Must be able to climb a ladder to clean windows, stock shelves, make price changes, etc.
  2. Daily Standing, Pushing, Pulling, Reaching, Bending, Squatting, Climbing, Walking and Lifting up to 50 lbs.

  4. Exposed to extreme weather conditions and temperatures.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees.

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

The Release Manager role will be responsible for deploying builds across the environment, on-boarding new environment , Handling transversal projects and create release management related document and share release plan with the stakeholders

  • Communicate all key project plans, commitments, and changes including QA plans, schedule, and scope changes.
  • Conduct Release Readiness reviews, Milestone Reviews, and Business Go/No-Go reviews with stakeholders
  • Produce Deployment, Run Books and Implementation Plans
  • Participate in CAB meetings to present Production changes (RFCs)
  • Lead and co-ordinate the Go-Live activities including the execution of the deployment Plans and checklists.
  • Weekly Release Reporting with Program release manager.
  • Own and continually improve the release process by documenting release issues and developing plans to improve processes, able to recommend continuous improvements viz: automation .
  • Comfortable in interacting with people across hierarchical levels for smooth project execution. Enjoys managing complex projects involving challenges.
Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • English Language is mandatory to collaborate in a global environment, including writing, speaking and presenting.
  • Understanding of Continuous Delivery and Continuous Integration (CD/CI) pipelines
  • Good understanding of cloud deployment, preferably Azure and Agile practice
  • Knowledge on Deployment tool like Octopus

  • Document Management for adhere to Audit Compliance process is an added advantage
  • 4 to 5 years of relevant release and deployment management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional work teams towards task completion
  • Demonstrated effective leadership and analytical skills
  • Strong in troubleshooting and organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
    Desired Technical Stack:
  • Platforms : Windows, Linux.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.
This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.
Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team
What we are looking for in you
  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Lar das marcas de higiene, saúde e nutrição mais amadas e confiáveis do mundo. Nosso propósito define a razão pela qual existimos: proteger, curar e nutrir na busca incansável por um mundo mais limpo e saudável. Somos uma equipe global unida por esse propósito.

Junte-se a nós em nossa luta para tornar o acesso à higiene, ao bem-estar e à nutrição da qualidade um direito e não um privilégio.

Time

Nossa equipe comercial ajuda a cumprir o propósito da Reckitt, construindo sucesso compartilhado com nossos clientes, possibilitando acesso à higiene, bem-estar e nutrição da mais alta qualidade possível nas lojas e online.

Em Vendas, estamos focados em alcançar desempenho superior em todos os nossos canais, operando em categorias altamente competitivas. Esse foco resulta em um ambiente dinmico e rápido, onde as equipes multifuncionais são incentivadas a colaborar para alcançar o sucesso.

Temos cerca de 10.000 vendedores em todo o mundo, e em áreas como vendas de campo, key-accounts, trade marketing e gestão de categorias.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Desenvolver comercialmente duas redes da região Sul com objetivo de atingir os planos e crescimentos definidos. Garantindo a execução da estratégia de nossas marcas, com foco em Sell out e presença.

Suas responsabilidades

• Planejar e organizar as atividades diárias de visitas à clientes; analisando a necessidade de cada conta, buscando o atingimento dos objetivos;
• Implementar o calendário promocional e as ações de trade marketing definidas pela companhia, assegurando as diretrizes de visibilidade e sortimento correto;
• Planejar, conduzir e liderar revisões de negócio e JBP com os principais clientes, bem como acompanhamento mensal dos resultados alinhados com a estratégia;
• Analisar dados de mercado (IQVIA), criar diagnóstico e construir planos de ações;
• Assegurar o uso correto dos investimentos, acompanhamento de ROI e metas de crescimento;
• Acompanhar as alterações e lançamentos de novos produtos, visando atingir a distribuição e giro estabelecidos pela Cia.
• Monitorar de perto as tendências do mercado e dos concorrentes para identificar e capturar oportunidades de vendas;
• Construir relacionamento com as áreas de Trade, GC, Supply e E-commerce com o objetivo de integrar e promover novas soluções para o portfólio da Reckitt;
• Desenvolver o potencial dos clientes do território com harmonia comercial na região;
• Capacidade de construir uma venda persuasiva, relatórios de acompanhamento de negócio, assim como suportar o crescimento dos clientes;
• Back Office, controle de pagamentos, conta corrente, fechamento de ações, comprovações de verba e contratos.

Estamos em busca das seguintes vivências

• Superior Completo
• Avançada em pacote Excel e PPT.
• Inglês intermediário.
• Ter experiência no Canal Farma e em Trade Marketing será um diferencial.

Habilidades

• Que seja predominante o relacionamento, proatividade, capacidade analítica, disciplina operacional e resiliência.

O que oferecemos

Com a inclusão no centro de tudo o que fazemos, trabalhando em conjunto com os nossos Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), apoiamos os nossos colaboradores em cada etapa da sua jornada profissional, ajudando-os a ter sucesso à sua maneira individual.
Investimos no bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores por meio de benefícios parentais, um Programa de Assistência ao Colaborador para promover a saúde mental, seguro de vida para todos os colaboradores e uma série de outros benefícios alinhados ao mercado local.
Além disso, por meio dos nossos planos de ações globais, oferecemos a oportunidade de poupar e partilhar os potenciais sucessos futuros do Grupo Reckitt. Para funções elegíveis, também oferecemos incentivos de curto prazo para reconhecer, valorizar e recompensar o seu trabalho pela entrega de resultados excepcionais, de acordo com a filosofia de pagamento por desempenho do Grupo Reckitt.

Igualdade de oportunidade

Sabemos que, nem sempre, se tem todos os requisitos pedidos para uma posição. É por isso que o Grupo Reckitt contrata não apenas por experiência de trabalho, mas também com base no potencial e nas competências do candidato. Por isso, ainda que não tenha todos os requisitos descritos, se você acredita que esta oportunidade e nossa empresa são para você, queremos te conhecer melhor!

Reforçamos que todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para a oportunidade independentemente de fatores como idade, incapacidade ou condição médica, cor, etnia, cidadania, nacionalidade, religião, gestação, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero ou qualquer outro.

O Grupo Reckitt não realiza cobranças para a participação em processos seletivos. Caso receba alguma mensagem solicitando pagamento, não responda e entre em contato conosco através das redes sociais ou SAC.

Seguindo a política de direitos humanos, não contratamos menores de 18 anos para essa função.

title: Hardware Test Engineer - Electronics
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Hardware Test Engineer for Electronics, you will be deeply involved in the electrical testing of hardware components and systems. Your expertise will be essential in executing a variety of electrical tests, from component-level analysis to system-wide functionality checks, ensuring all electronic products meet technical specifications and performance criteria.

Responsibilities

  • Design and conduct electrical tests such as signal integrity, power loading, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) using oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and network analyzers.
  • Implement embedded firmware for microcontrollers to simulate operational conditions for electronic testing.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot circuitry issues using multimeters, logic analyzers, and in-circuit emulators.
  • Collaborate with design engineers to refine PCB layouts and circuit designs based on test findings.
  • Document all test results and develop reports that outline findings, conclusions, and recommendations for improvements.
  • Stay current with advancements in electronic testing equipment and techniques.
  • Adhere to and enforce compliance with electronic safety standards and regulations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience with hands-on electronic hardware testing and debugging.
  • Strong proficiency with electronic test equipment and diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of printed circuit board (PCB) design and testing, including familiarity with EDA tools like KiCad or Altium Designer.
  • Solid understanding of digital and analog circuitry, as well as experience with power electronics.
  • Ability to read and interpret electronic schematics and datasheets.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with RF testing and wireless communications standards.
  • Involvement in open-source hardware projects or community electronics groups.
  • Fluent in English.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

  • Competent in the assessment, treatment, counseling, and education of the patient, and their families, being provided medical services.

Sobre o Stark Bank

No Stark Bank, somos mais que um banco digital para empresas: somos parceiros estratégicos que, desde 2018, vêm redefinindo o futuro dos serviços financeiros corporativos no Brasil. Oferecemos uma gama completa de serviços, desde o processamento ágil de pagamentos e faturas até a gestão inteligente de contas a receber, tudo integrado e automatizado através de uma API robusta e inovadora. Não nos contentamos em apenas otimizar processos; ambicionamos nos tornar o maior banco em tecnologia financeira, capacitando negócios a prosperarem com soluções que eliminam burocracias e impulsionam a eficiência.

Acreditamos que a chave para revolucionar o sistema financeiro reside na nossa busca incessante por inovação e na nossa capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em soluções impactantes. Cada linha de código, cada nova funcionalidade que desenvolvemos, é destinada a permitir que as empresas foquem no que realmente importa: estratégia e crescimento.

Nosso legado é ambicioso: construir o melhor ecossistema bancário em tecnologia e atendimento para empresas no Brasil. E para alcançar essa visão, precisamos de mentes curiosas, persistentes e apaixonadas por desafios. Se você se identifica com a minuciosidade, consistência e persistência que nos movem, se acredita na melhoria constante e coloca o cliente no centro de suas ações, e se busca um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador onde a ambição encontra a oportunidade de escalar, o Stark Bank é o seu lugar.

O desafio:

Responsável por auxiliar na implementação e manutenção do programa de Compliance, com foco específico na Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro (PLD) e no monitoramento de transações em nossa instituição de pagamentos. Irá atuar na análise de alertas, investigação de atividades suspeitas, desenvolvimento e aplicação de políticas e procedimentos, garantindo a conformidade com as regulamentações vigentes e contribuindo para a proteção da empresa contra riscos de LD/FT.


Você irá:
  • Monitoramento e Análise de Transações: Realizar o monitoramento de transações para identificar atividades suspeitas, analisando alertas e investigando casos potenciais de LD/FT.
  • Conformidade Regulatória e Políticas: Auxiliar na implementação e atualização de políticas e procedimentos de PLD/FT, garantindo o alinhamento com as regulamentações e normas internas.
  • Análise de Due Diligence e KYC: Apoiar a execução de processos de Conheça seu Cliente (KYC) e Due Diligence, avaliando o risco de clientes e transações.
  • Suporte à Avaliação de Riscos: Contribuir para a identificação, avaliação e mitigação dos riscos de LD/FT da instituição.
  • Elaboração de Relatórios e Documentação: Preparar relatórios de análises e investigações, além de auxiliar na documentação dos processos de PLD/FT.
  • Participação em Treinamentos e Projetos: Colaborar em treinamentos sobre PLD/FT e participar de projetos de melhoria contínua na área de Compliance.
O que nao pode faltar:
  • Experiência prévia (mínimo de 5 anos) na área de Compliance, com foco em Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e monitoramento de transações, preferencialmente em instituições financeiras ou de pagamentos.
  • Sólido conhecimento da legislação e regulamentação de PLD/FT no Brasil (Lei nº 9.613/1998 , regulamentação do Banco Central, COAF, etc.).
  • Experiência com sistemas e ferramentas de monitoramento de transações.
  • Capacidade analítica e crítica para interpretar dados e identificar padrões suspeitos.
  • Habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita para elaboração de relatórios e interação com diferentes áreas.
O que aumenta suas chances:
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados e ferramentas de BI.
  • Certificações na área de Compliance ou PLD.
  • Proficiência em inglês.

O que Oferecemos:

Oportunidade de trabalhar em uma empresa dinâmica e em crescimento no setor de pagamentos.

Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e desafiador.

Possibilidade de desenvolvimento profissional.

Pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo com o mercado.

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbours, and rivers. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 in Marine and Port Facilities and among the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare specifications, interpret field test data (SPT, sCPT, FVST, DMT) and estimate soil engineering properties for foundation design and soil-structure interaction (SSI)
  • Recommend and monitor lab tests on items in a laboratory. Interpret results, analyze soil properties, note any contamination or other issues, and produce reports about their findings for project managers
  • Perform construction site inspections and prepare inspection reports
  • Perform geostructural analysis and design of waterfront structures, including bulkheads, retaining walls, deep foundations, and flood control structures
  • Design wall structural components, including wales, tie rods, tiebacks, cap beams, etc., comprising local and global soil stability
  • Design of buried structures
  • Design and preparation of construction drawings and contract documents

Description and Requirements

Lenovo is launching a new Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) digital business in Brazil, focused on driving direct sales of server, storage, and infrastructure products through Lenovo.com.br. As the ISG Brazil eCommerce Program Manager , you will lead the end-to-end go-to-market strategy and business operations for this critical initiative, with a strong focus on accelerating growth in Brazil’s B2B market.

This is a highly strategic and cross-functional role requiring deep ownership of ISG eCommerce processes. You will work closely with Brazil’s ISG 4P and Sales teams, as well as Lenovo’s global eCommerce organization, to deliver on revenue targets, shape the customer experience, and drive digital transformation within the ISG business.

You will own Brazil’s ISG eCommerce 4P strategy across Product, Price, Place, and Promotion, and be responsible for launching and managing performance marketing programs to generate leads, influence pipeline, and convert web traffic into sales. This is a unique opportunity to help build a business from the ground up and directly impact Lenovo’s global growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities

4P Strategy Ownership (Brazil ISG eCommerce)

  • Product: Define the ideal ISG eCommerce product portfolio (servers, storage, and options) for Lenovo.com in Brazil, in close collaboration with local 4P and global product and category teams.
  • Pricing: Lead Brazil-specific web pricing strategy, including promotions, deal structures, and competitive price factor value (PFV) benchmarking, in coordination with ISG Pricing and eCommerce operations.
  • Place: Position Lenovo.com.br as a key digital touchpoint for B2B ISG sales in Brazil, while supporting an integrated, omnichannel go-to-market approach in collaboration with channel partners.
  • Promotion: Develop and execute localized digital marketing demand generation campaigns aligned with ISG sales priorities, leveraging paid media, email, and account-based marketing.

Program Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead Brazil’s ISG Web go-to-market planning, forecasting, and campaign execution in alignment with Sales, ISG 4P, Supply Chain, Channel/Reseller, and eCommerce teams.
  • Partner with Lenovo’s global eCommerce organization (site operations, merchandising, UX, BT/IT, and pricing operations) to deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Lenovo.com.br
  • Own and manage key business KPIs, including overall sales and profit contribution, web traffic, conversion rates, leads, ROAS and generated pipeline.

Market Activation & Reporting

  • Represent the Brazil ISG Web business in global strategy discussions and regular business reviews, ensuring alignment with broader ISG and eCommerce goals.
  • Serve as the local subject matter expert, surfacing market-specific needs, blockers, and growth opportunities to influence global strategy and investment planning.
  • Collaborate with Lenovo’s appointed digital agency to plan, execute, and optimize demand generation campaigns across SEM, paid social, and programmatic channels — ensuring media budgets are aligned to campaign goals and delivering measurable results.
  • Lead the creative briefing process, audience targeting strategy, localization requirements, and campaign calendar in collaboration with the agency and global marketing teams.
  • Monitor campaign performance, supporting continuous optimization through A/B testing, segmentation, and funnel analysis.
  • Provide ongoing reporting, insights, and strategic recommendations using marketing automation tools (e.g., BlueCore), web analytics, and Microsoft Dynamics.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 6–10 years of experience in B2B marketing, product/portfolio management, or digital program leadership.
  • Proven track record of launching or scaling digital marketing and demand generation programs in Brazil or LATAM.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s B2B and IT infrastructure landscape.
  • Experience collaborating across functions such as Sales, Product Management, Pricing, and eCommerce.
  • Familiarity with servers, storage, or other data center infrastructure solutions is required.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and proficient in English.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment with distributed teams.

Why Join Lenovo?

  • Collaborate with global leaders across marketing, sales, and digital commerce.
  • Competitive salary, performance incentives, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Join a culture that values innovation, inclusion, and agility.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.


With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.


Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talentedSenior DevSecOps / Cloud Security Engineer to join our Technology Department, with a focus on strengthening and automating our security posture across cloud and hybrid infrastructure.

We are open to hiring this role inLisbon, Portugal , orSão Paulo, Brazil.

As a DevSecOps /Cloud Security Engineer, you will be responsible for embedding security into every stage of our infrastructure lifecycle, from design to deployment. You will lead the implementation of cloud-native security controls in AWS, harden Kubernetes environments, and drive best practices across CI/CD pipelines. Your role includes continuous vulnerability management, network protection, monitoring for threats, and working with development, DevOps and IP teams to ensure secure-by-default practices. You’ll also proactively identify risks, secure network perimeters, and automate remediation wherever possible.

A new hire in Sao Paulo would spend their first week in Lisbon/Berlin for onboarding.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable cloud security controls in AWS multi-account environments
  • Lead Kubernetes security architecture, including PodSecurity, RBAC, and network policies
  • Enforcezero trust network architecture and secure segmentation across cloud and hybrid environments
  • Integrate security automation into CI/CD pipelines (image scanning, SAST, IaC analysis)
  • Deploy and manage CrowdStrike, Tenable, and similar endpoint and vulnerability management tools
  • Continuously monitor infrastructure for vulnerabilities, threats, and misconfigurations
  • Enforce least privilege IAM policies and secure secrets management
  • Conduct regular audits, penetration testing, and hardening of cloud workloads and host systems
  • Conductnetwork traffic inspection using tools like VPC Flow Logs, packet capture, or NetFlow
  • Collaborate with DevOps and IP teams on security-as-code principles
  • Maintain compliance with internal policies and external standards (e.g. CIS, NIST, ISO 27001)
  • Tune and respond to alerts from WAF, IDS/IPS, and SIEM systems
  • Document security controls, incident response playbooks, and operational runbooks
  • Champion a security-first culture through collaboration, training, and awareness

Minimum Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years in DevSecOps, Cloud Security, or Infrastructure Security roles
  • Strong expertise in AWS security services (IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Config, Security Hub, etc.)
  • In-depth understanding ofnetwork security principles (firewalls, routing, segmentation, VPNs, IPsec, etc.)
  • Proven hands-on experience with Kubernetes security (RBAC, NetworkPolicies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Admission Controllers)
  • Experience operating CrowdStrike Falcon and Tenable Nessus / Tenable.io
  • Experience with WAFs, DDoS protection,NIDS/NIPS, and threat intelligence integrations
  • Comfortable withpacket inspection, flow analysis, and traffic monitoring (tcpdump, Wireshark, Suricata, etc.)
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt) and configuration management (Ansible, Packer)
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Go, or Bash) for automation and tooling
  • Solid understanding of Linux security hardening and secure cloud networking
  • Familiarity with service mesh security in Istio or similar
  • Experience with GitOps workflows using tools like Argo CD or Flux
  • Understanding of vulnerability management, secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), and security controls for containers
  • Exposure to compliance frameworks like ISO 27001, SOC2, NIST, PCI-DSS is a plus
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset
  • Certifications such as AWS Certified Security Specialty, CKS, OSCP, or CISSP is a plus
  • Experience with multi-cloud security (Azure/GCP)
  • Background in ethical hacking, bug bounty programs, or red teaming
  • Familiarity with tools like Falco, Sysdig, Trivy, or eBPF-based runtime security tools

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.
